sentences.text:
1 2. By this application under Section 438, Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 [CrPC], the petitioner viz. Afjal Hussain Laskar @ Abjur Hussain Laskar has Page No.# 2/2 approached this Court seeking the benefit of pre-arrest bail, apprehending his arrest, in connection with Silchar Police Station Case no. 3680/2021, registered for offences punishable under Sections 448/376/341/294/506/34,
Indian Penal Code [IPC].
3.

entities.text: Afjal Hussain Laskar @ Abjur Hussain Laskar
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
Mr. Sharma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that after completion of investigation in connection with Silchar Police Station Case no. 3680/2021, the Investigating Officer [I.O.] of the case has submitted a charge sheet under Section 173[2], CrPC being Charge Sheet no.
1080/2022 dated 29.10.2022.
4.

In view of the submission of the charge sheet in the case, Mr. Hazarika, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner will approach the learned jurisdictional trial court seeking regular bail.
5. In view of the said submission of Mr. Hazarika, this application stands closed, granting liberty to the petitioner to approach the learned jurisdictional trial Court.

6. In the event the petitioner approaches the learned jurisdictional trial court by filing any application seeking regular bail, the learned jurisdictional trial court shall consider such application on its own merits and in accordance with law.
